display_long_description:
# Just when you thought you were out, we're pulling you back in,  Agent!

Outwit your most cunning adversary yet in the newest chapter of this beloved spy puzzle series. Wield new gadgets, explore action-packed locales, and slip into custom disguises in this VR escape room.

[media]

Your skills — and survival rate — make you one of our top agents, and you've resurfaced just in time. Zoraxis is plotting something new, and it could be dire if we don't intervene. Protect the Agency and the world, without losing your wits...or your life! 

# Race to Beat Dr. Prism
Your assignments unfold across some of the most dangerous, expansive locales yet, each demanding your sharpest covert skills. These fast-paced missions will leave you breathless.

[media]


# Meet a Brilliant Mastermind

Dr. Roxana Prism, scientist and former Agency inventor, believes she can build a better agent — one superior to any human. And she has her sights set on you. Survive long enough to stop this escalating threat.

[media]

# Go Undercover in Style

Show off your (undercover) style with an inventive lineup of Agency-approved attire. Suit up with your favorite hat, watch, and gloves before your next top-secret mission.
[media]

- 88/100 Critical Score
- 100% Recommendation Rate
- NYX - Independent GOTY 2024
- NYX - Meta Quest VR Escape Room Game
- NYX - Meta Quest VR Puzzle Game
- XR Accolade: Story-Driven Experience
- Telly Awards: Silver, Use of VR

[media]

**Join our Discord server for all the latest intel!**
